question: The circumference of a circle is 132 cm. The radius of the given circle is equal to the radius of a cone having height 12 cm. Find the volume of the cone. (Take π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Circumference = 132

Height of cone = 12

π = 22 ÷ 7

**Formula Used:**

Circumference = 2 × π × r

Volume of cone = (1 ÷ 3) × π × r² × h

**Calculation:**

⇒ 132 = 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × r

⇒ 132 = (44 ÷ 7) × r

⇒ r = 132 × (7 ÷ 44)

⇒ r = 21

⇒ Volume = (1 ÷ 3) × (22 ÷ 7) × 21² × 12

⇒ Volume = (1 ÷ 3) × (22 ÷ 7) × 441 × 12

⇒ Volume = (1 ÷ 3) × 22 × 63 × 12

⇒ Volume = (1 ÷ 3) × 16632

⇒ Volume = 5544

**∴ The correct answer is 5544.**
